novelty_weight.description: Novelty Weight computed from Validity, Impact, and Similarity

components.V: Validity score [0,1] - how valid/correct the input is
components.I: Impact score [0,1] - how significant the input is
components.S: Similarity score [0,1] - how similar to existing knowledge (penalized)

unlock_mechanics.heavy_unlock: If NW >= 0.7 and eligible: p_max += 1, tokens = 0, cooldown = K
unlock_mechanics.count_unlock: If tokens >= N_threshold and eligible: p_max += 1, tokens = 0, cooldown = K

high_stakes.description: High-stakes score from Uncertainty, Known-risk, and Autonomy

gating_rules.conditions: admin_unlock=true AND verifier PASS AND replay passed AND cooldown_left==0
